description: When personal data has been made public or disclosed to recipients, erasure requests are not communicated to those recipients. Controllers must take reasonable steps to inform processors of erasure.
applicability: Applicable when personal data has been shared with third parties or made publicly available. Includes data sharing partners and search engines for public data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data sharing relationships and erasure notification procedures. Verify mechanisms to notify all recipients of erasure requests.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter III - Rights of the Data Subject

sources.title: EDPB Guidelines on Data Subject Rights
